module.purpose: Provides a sorted entity state adapter factory for NgRx-style entity collections, keeping items sorted by a caller-supplied comparer and offering mutating add/set/update/upsert methods wrapped as immutable state operators.
module.summary: This module exports a binary-search insertion helper and a factory that builds an entity state adapter maintaining a sorted list of entities. The factory reuses an unsorted adapter for removals and defines internal mutating functions for add/set/update/upsert that delegate to a merge function. The merge function rebuilds a sorted id array, handling empty states, applied updates, and id swaps. Methods are wrapped via createStateOperator to present an immutable-looking API.
module.businessContext: Supports sorted entity state management in Redux/NgRx-like stores. Failure breaks ordering guarantees and UI lists reliant on sorted entities.

detail.name: mergeFunction
detail.signature: const mergeFunction: MergeFunction = (state, addedItems, appliedUpdates, replacedIds) => { ... }
preconditions: state exposes entities and ids that are retrievable via getCurrent (may be Current-wrapped).
selectId and comparer are bound from the enclosing createSortedStateAdapter closure.
addedItems is an iterable collection of entities.
state.entities is writable so the returned Record<Id, T> can receive item assignments.
postconditions: Every entity in addedItems is present in state.entities keyed by selectId(item), overwriting any pre-existing entity with the same id.
All previously existing entities retained by their ids remain keyed in state.entities.
newSortedIds is the selectId projection of sortedEntities ordered by comparer.
If areArraysEqual(currentIds, newSortedIds) is false, state.ids is reassigned to newSortedIds; otherwise state.ids is left unchanged.
invariants: Whenever state.ids is reassigned, it equals the selectId projection of entities sorted by comparer.
state.entities remains a Record<Id, T> mapping id to entity.
sortedEntities is sorted by comparer at the point newSortedIds is derived.
edgeCases: Empty addedItems with non-empty current state: sortedEntities carries the current entities; no binary insert occurs; newSortedIds is derived and state.ids is updated only if the sorted projection differs from currentIds.
wasPreviouslyEmpty === true (no current entities collected): sortedEntities is replaced by addedItems.slice().sort(comparer) so the full incoming set is freshly sorted rather than binary-inserted.
replacedIds truthy: ids is rebuilt as a Set of currentIds so any duplicate ids are deduplicated before collecting sortedEntities.
wasPreviouslyEmpty === false and appliedUpdates truthy: the mostly-sorted sortedEntities (with new items binary-inserted) is re-sorted with comparer to restore total order.
wasPreviouslyEmpty === false and appliedUpdates falsy: new items are binary-inserted via insert and the array is NOT re-sorted, relying on insert maintaining sorted order.
currentIds and newSortedIds compare equal via areArraysEqual: state.ids is not reassigned, avoiding a spurious mutation.
stateMutations: state.entities (mutated via stateEntities assignments for each added item)
state.ids (conditionally reassigned to newSortedIds when id sequence changes)
detail.summary: Merges added and updated entities into the sorted state adapter's entities, preserving the order enforced by the comparer, and reassigns state.ids only when the resulting id sequence differs from the current one.
